in_marathi.name: Damu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Damu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit term ‘daam’, meaning ‘to protect’ or ‘God’s protector’. This name is often given to boys in Hindu culture, symbolizing strength, courage, and divine protection.
